dot_liveness.source: At exact probe fbf3, pixel.Filter calls filterSixNarrow8 only for len(taps)==6. All production VP9 pixel.Filter callers are convolveHoriz/Vert, passing full xFilters/yFilters phase arrays of tables.SubpelTaps=8 (no trimming), so gated six-tap helper is not selected for VP9. Shared generic Filter is live but unchanged for eight taps.
dot_liveness.limit: VP8 dot has only10ms sampled cumCPU (~0.42% of2.38s); six-narrow70ms includes nested helpers. Sparse sampling does not measure exact encoder speed contribution. VP9+0.754% public regression cannot be attributed to executed dot arithmetic: shared eight-tap entry is reachable, new helper is not. Code/link layout or variation are hypotheses, not measured causes.
